title: 리딩인사이드 스타터 UNIT 09 Ice 문장
source: Reading Inside Starter Answer Key — 구문 해설 인용문 + 워크북 WRITING TEST 정답 청크(해석은 교재 해석 발췌)

grammar.evidence: R1 Check Up: 그의 친구들을 만나기 위해 / 질문을 하기 위해 · R2 Check Up: many places / any money · WB GRAMMAR TEST A any secrets/something, B money to take·homework to do·to borrow some books, C 나는 너에게 말할 것이 있다 / 입학하기 위해 등

sentences.title: The Coolest Music in the World
sentences.en: Surprisingly, the instruments are made of ice.

sentences.title: The Coolest Music in the World
sentences.en: Also, the instruments must be retuned between songs to maintain their sound.
sentences.ko: 또한, 악기들은 소리를 유지하기 위해서 곡들 사이에 다시 조율되어야 한다.

sentences.title: The Coolest Music in the World
sentences.en: This is because they melt a little each time they are played.
sentences.ko: 그것들은 연주될 때마다 조금씩 녹기 때문이다.

sentences.title: The Coolest Music in the World
sentences.en: But sadly, they must be kept short to prevent the audience from freezing and the instruments from melting!
sentences.ko: 하지만 아쉽게도, 그것은 관중이 너무 추워하거나 악기가 녹는 것을 막기 위해 짧게 유지되어야 한다!

sentences.title: The Ice King
sentences.en: These days, ice is cheap and can be bought easily.
sentences.ko: 요즘에, 얼음은 저렴하고 쉽게 구매될 수 있다.

sentences.title: The Ice King
sentences.en: But before refrigerators were invented, ice was rare.
sentences.ko: 하지만 냉장고가 발명되기 전에 얼음은 희귀했다.

sentences.title: The Ice King
sentences.en: He came up with the idea to take ice from frozen winter ponds and ship …
sentences.ko: 그는 꽁꽁 언 겨울 연못에서 얼음을 가져다 운송할 아이디어를 생각해냈다.
sentences.point: 명사 수식 to부정사, and로 (to) ship 병렬

sentences.title: The Ice King
sentences.en: At first, most of the ice Tudor tried to ship did melt.
sentences.ko: 처음에는, Tudor가 운송하려 했던 얼음의 대부분이 정말 녹아버렸다.

sentences.title: The Ice King
sentences.en: But later, he discovered a way to store the ice by packing it in sawdust.
sentences.ko: 하지만 나중에, 그는 톱밥으로 얼음을 싸서 저장하는 방법을 알아냈다.

sentences.title: The Ice King
sentences.en: For example, he gave bartenders free ice to try.
sentences.ko: 예를 들어, 그는 바텐더들에게 사용해 볼 무료 얼음을 제공했다.
sentences.point: 명사 수식 형용사적 to부정사: 사용해 볼

quiz.q: People gather ____ the ice music orchestra. (hear)
I have a lot of homework ____ tonight. (do)
She turned on the computer ____ her email. (check)
He gave bartenders free ice (to try / trying).
Tudor found a way (to store / stores) the ice.
I went to the store buy some groceries.
quiz.a: I went to the store to buy some groceries.
I have something to tell you.
